svg.title: Writing speed on a MacBook Pro M3 Max
svg.desc: Line chart of writing speed against conversation length: DeepSeek starts at 22 tokens per second and falls steadily to 17 by 64K, while GLM starts at 17 and stays nearly flat around 15
svg.text: Writing speed on a MacBook Pro M3 Max
Tokens produced per second once the answer has started. Higher is better.
Context length (tokens already in the conversation)
